About this Report

As a non-financial report publicly disclosed by Beijing Enterprises Water Group Limited, this report aims at responding to the expectations of stakeholders and comprehensively demonstrating the Group's concepts, management, actions and achievements in environmental, social and governance ("ESG") and sustainable development. This report has been reviewed and approved by the Board of Directors (the "Board") of Beijing Enterprises Water Group Limited, which guarantees that there are no false records, misleading statements or material omissions in this report.

Message from the Chairman

Water governance follows constant principles, and so too does enterprise management. As we approach the culmination of "14th Five-Year Plan" period, BEWG has remained steadfast in its commitment to national priorities, navigating by the blueprint set forth at the National People's Congress and attuning ourselves to the evolving imperatives of the new development paradigm. BEWG integrates industry investment, design, construction, operation, technical services and capital operation, and relies on technology and innovative models for new business growth to realise corporate sustainability. Stakeholder Engagement

BEWG highly values the expectations and demands of all stakeholders, and listens to the opinions and suggestions of the government, shareholders, customers, communities, employees and other stakeholders through different channels to improve the Group's ESG performance in a targeted manner.

Resources Recovery

The Group fully embraces the concept of water conservation, strengthens control and management throughout the entire project lifecycle, and systematically promotes the efficient use of water resources with a focus on water conservation and efficiency improvement. We are exploring diversified reuse of non-conventional water sources, such as reclaimed water, and are committed to building a sustainable water resource recycling system.

By establishing open dialogue platforms, we aim to foster industry exchanges, accelerate technological innovation, drive industry progress, and empower sustainable development.

This end-to-end closed loop management drives the efficient transfer and transformation of employees’ professional competencies, enables the iterative upgrade to the existing talent structure and continuously unleashes the development potential of the talent pool.
